blocks.title: Storytelling
blocks.text: Storytelling uses words, images and emotions to create a narrative that engages an audience, capturing attention, simplifying complex ideas and helping the message stay in memory.

In a school debate on 'Should plastic bags be banned?', telling of a beach visit where plastic waste harmed marine life makes the argument more relatable and convincing. Stories such as Heer Ranjha and Sassi Punnu have been passed down for generations, teaching lessons about love, bravery and sacrifice (Did You Know).
